title: Top 10 Best Single-Serve Coffee Makers in 2026
content:
# Top 10 Best Single-Serve Coffee Makers in 2026

Single-serve coffee makers offer convenience without sacrificing quality. Whether you prefer pods, grounds, or capsules, there is a machine for every coffee habit. After testing 18 single-serve brewers, here are our top picks for 2026.

## Quick Comparison Table

| Rank | Product | Price | Type | Brew Sizes | Reservoir | Rating |
|------|---------|-------|------|-----------|-----------|--------|
| 1 | Keurig K-Elite | $149.99 | Pod | 4-12oz | 75oz | ★★★★★ |
| 2 | Nespresso Vertuo Pop+ | $129.99 | Capsule | 5 sizes | 20oz | ★★★★★ |
| 3 | Breville Beside Single | $199.95 | Grounds | 6-12oz | 50oz | ★★★★★ |
| 4 | Keurig K-Mini Plus | $89.99 | Pod | 6-12oz | 12oz | ★★★★☆ |
| 5 | Ninja Hot and Cold | $179.99 | Pod/Ground | 4 sizes | 60oz | ★★★★☆ |
| 6 | Hamilton Beach 25C | $39.99 | Pod | 6-10oz | Removable | ★★★☆☆ |
| 7 | Cuisinart SS-15 | $99.99 | Pod | 6-14oz | 40oz | ★★★★☆ |
| 8 | Mr. Coffee One-Touch | $49.99 | Pod | 4-14oz | Removable | ★★★☆☆ |
| 9 | DeLonghi MultiServe | $199.99 | Pod/Ground | 3-16oz | 60oz | ★★★★☆ |
| 10 | Pod Star P1 | $29.99 | Pod | 6-12oz | 16oz | ★★★☆☆ |

## Our Top Picks in Detail

### 1. Keurig K-Elite - Best Overall

The Keurig K-Elite is the most popular single-serve coffee maker. It brews 4-12oz cups with strong and iced coffee settings, and the 75oz removable reservoir means fewer refills. The hot water on demand function is perfect for tea. At $149.99, it offers versatility and reliability.

**Price:** $149.99 | **Where to buy:** [Amazon](https://amazon.com)

---

### 2. Nespresso Vertuo Pop+ - Best for Espresso

Nespresso Vertuo technology uses centrifusion to brew the perfect espresso from proprietary capsules. The Vertuo Pop+ is the most compact Vertuo machine. At $129.99, it delivers cafe-quality espresso consistently. The 20oz water reservoir and fast heat-up time make morning routines effortless.

**Price:** $129.99 | **Where to buy:** [Amazon](https://amazon.com)

---

### 3. Breville Beside Single Cup - Best for Grounds Lovers

The Breville Beside Single Cup lets you use both pods and ground coffee. The dose control grinding feature grinds beans fresh for each cup. At $199.95, it is the most expensive, but the dual functionality justifies the price for serious coffee enthusiasts.

**Price:** $199.95 | **Where to buy:** [Amazon](https://amazon.com)

---

### 4. Keurig K-Mini Plus - Best Compact

The Keurig K-Mini Plus is the sleekest single-serve machine available. At just 4.5 inches wide, it fits anywhere. The 12oz removable reservoir is easy to fill. At $89.99, it is affordable and elegant.

**Price:** $89.99 | **Where to buy:** [Amazon](https://amazon.com)

---

### 5. Ninja Hot and Cold Brewed System - Best Multi-Function

The Ninja Hot and Cold Brewed System is a true all-in-one coffee station. It brews hot coffee, cold brew, specialty drinks, and tea from pods or grounds. The built-in frother creates lattes and cappuccinos at home. At $179.99, it replaces multiple appliances.

**Price:** $179.99 | **Where to buy:** [Amazon](https://amazon.com)

---

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: Are K-Cup pods bad for the environment?**
A: Keurig has introduced recyclable K-Cup pods. Consider reusable filters to reduce waste.

**Q: Can I use my own grounds in a Keurig?**
A: Yes. Keurig sells a MyK cup reusable filter.

---

## Final Verdict

For most households, the **Keurig K-Elite at $149.99** is the best balance. If you love espresso, the **Nespresso Vertuo Pop+ at $129.99** delivers cafe-quality results. And for versatility, the **Ninja Hot and Cold at $179.99** is the ultimate all-in-one solution.
